submitted.rationale: Of the 5 measured compositions, index 23 (Sb 0.804) had the highest EQE at 0.00453%. The Sb-rich end of the line gave the best results: its neighbor index 27 (Sb 0.8116) measured 0.00443%. All EQE values are very low, which fits the wide band gaps of Zn–Sb oxides under 2.7 eV illumination.
